title: Anyone else getting old-school Top Gear vibes?

description:
Does Toyota create the best off-roaders? 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-01-10-26

It’s time for a Toyota off-road head-to-head! 

We’ve got our hands on the all-new Toyota Hilux, and it’s going up against the Toyota Land Cruiser in a series of off-road challenges! 

The question is, which of these off-road legends will perform the best? Let’s take a closer look at the stats… 

Starting with the Toyota Hilux, it’s powered by a 2.8-litre 4-cylinder diesel which produces 204hp and 500Nm. It has a locking rear differential, low- and high-range modes, as well as multi-terrain driving options. It weighs in at least 2,175kg.

As for the Land Cruiser, it’s also powered by a 2.8-litre 4-cylinder, and the power output is (unsurprisingly) identical, coming in at 204hp and 500Nm. However, while it may have off-road tech and features like the Hilux, not only is it heavier (at 2,335kg), but it’s also only on road tyres!
